scope: Independent static adversarial replay/type/identity review during implementation. No production edits and no Maven run.

findings.title: Proof premise depth limit not enforced
findings.evidence: ProofChecker.local validates only premise index in [0,index). No code computes longest premise path. REFL(p,p), then 129 SYMM(p,p) steps each citing the preceding step passes the local rules and certificate budget.
findings.required_fix: Compute longest DAG path from prior step depths and reject beyond frozen depth 128; add boundary and over-limit tests.

findings.title: Recursive operations precede bounded validation
findings.evidence: ProofChecker.term evaluates value.cost() before traversing and checking nested depth. Term.cost recursively traverses all children. check also invokes record equality for input/context before structural validation, and Wire.size before validating proof step terms. Deep direct terms or hostile shared DAGs can exhaust stack/work before the intended depth/cost limit; catch RuntimeException does not catch StackOverflowError.
findings.required_fix: Bound term depth and occurrence count before cost/equality/hash/serialization. Preflight all step endpoints/substitutions/context atoms, not just input/output; ensure size/work allocation is capped.

findings.title: Atom inventory canonical ordering not checked
findings.evidence: validateContext uses HashSet uniqueness only; reversed distinct inventories pass despite frozen contract requiring exact lexicographic order. Trusted expected context prevents arbitrary certificate replacement, so this is a validation/contract gap rather than demonstrated false equivalence.
findings.required_fix: Validate canonical full (sort/schema, exact anonymous subtree) inventory order, with boundary test.

findings.title: Output size enforcement allocates complete amplified serialization before rejecting
findings.evidence: Wire.size calls json(value).getBytes(UTF_8).length, allocating whole JSON String and byte array. ProofChecker invokes it only after per-term limits, but 2048-occurrence terms and 4096 steps can repeat 131072-character allowed atoms. Per-term structural validation therefore does not bound serialization allocation to certificate_bytes_per_island=262144. ProofStore uses same operation.
findings.required_fix: Serialize into a capped counting/output sink that aborts after byte ceiling; do not allocate complete serialized artifact just to determine oversize.

positive_observations: Closed term operators and arities reject unknown operators. Sort constructor rejects unknown kind, zero/mixed arity, unsorted/duplicate alternatives and malformed nominal tokens.
Endpoint sort equality and ordered congruence premises preserve exact schema; SOME/NO require relational child and Boolean result.
Rule application requires registered rule identifier, exact variable set and same-sort substitutions with concrete endpoint equality.
Conclusion endpoints bind to original trusted EngineInput and output; context equality includes original atom inventory.
Proof checker does not consult union-find. Forward/self premise references reject.
trust_limits: No runtime reproduction has been executed by this seat. Findings follow directly from control flow and constructive counterexamples.
Implementation is changing concurrently; hashes identify reviewed snapshots.
No claim that fixed-schema validation proves Alloy Type.fold mapping or semantic source lowering.

recheck.resolved: ProofChecker iterative traversal preflights all certificate terms before recursive equality and serialization; proofDepth computes prior-edge longest paths bounded at128; validateContext checks Context.atomKey ordering.
recheck.execution: Static recheck only; author running tests separately.

final_recheck.disposition: All four findings addressed. Iterative structural preflight bounds term traversal before recursive operations; prior-premise DAG depths capped; atom inventory order checked; Wire.Counter streams size computation and aborts beyond262144 without complete artifact String allocation.
